claim: The sample demo produces a readiness receipt.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; bundled Arbor Desk sample; download and parse JSON

claim: The bundled demo runs offline after the page loads.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; set context offline; reset and complete recording

claim: No project data is uploaded during the demo.
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept every request during the complete demo; assert same-origin only

claim: The CLI writes JSON and HTML readiness receipts.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; rehearsal demo; parse JSON and inspect HTML

claim: The CLI checks backup, restore, and health hooks.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; bundled synthetic fixture; assert each receipt check passed

claim: The receipt records declared memory and disk minimums.
where: Open Graph and Twitter metadata, landing, README
sandbox: fresh temporary declaration with explicit memory and disk minimums; run the CLI and inspect the JSON receipt

claim: The CLI validates Compose and Kubernetes declarations before launch.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory for each adapter; valid schemas and no-op hooks; run check

claim: Installers verify SHA256 before placing the binary on PATH.
sandbox: read both shipped installers; assert checksum verification precedes installation

claim: Release v0.1.5 assets have GitHub provenance and installers can roll back to a tagged release after verifying its SHA256 checksum.
where: README verify and roll back section, GitHub Release notes
sandbox: fresh clone; recorded v0.1.5 release and GitHub attestation fixtures; match every published asset digest; inspect both version-aware installer scripts

claim: The core CLI is free under the MIT License.
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect LICENSE and Cargo package metadata

claim: Schema comparison records paths and types without copying values.
sandbox: fresh temporary declaration with distinct secret values; run all no-op hooks; inspect JSON receipt

claim: Customer-safe receipts omit declaration notes, hook output, and sample data.
where: landing, demo, README, receipt privacy copy, catalog description
sandbox: fresh temporary declaration with a sensitive note and hook output; run the CLI and assert neither appears in the JSON receipt

claim: The CLI uses a new temporary directory for rehearsal seed, backup, restore, and health checks.
sandbox: run the bundled demo without an output path; assert the isolated demo completes with a generated receipt

claim: Commands are argument arrays, so no shell parsing happens inside the CLI.
sandbox: run a declaration containing shell metacharacters in a hook argument; assert its literal command succeeds and no sentinel file is created

claim: A failed check returns exit code 1. Invalid input returns exit code 2.
sandbox: fresh declarations with a failing hook and invalid schema; assert process exit codes

claim: Published macOS and Windows packages are unsigned.
sandbox: inspect the release workflow and installation documentation for the unsigned package formats and absence of signing steps

claim: The CLI has no built-in network client or telemetry path.
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect dependencies and all Rust source for network clients, sockets, telemetry, and URLs

claim: A valid license restores the Team CI kit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; recorded valid verify response; return URL token; download and inspect CI kit

claim: The CLI checks one declared source-to-target upgrade path.
sandbox: fresh temporary declaration; run the CLI; assert exact source and target versions in the receipt

claim: The CLI has no built-in network client and does not discover customer installations; hooks can access configured paths and networks.
sandbox: hostile declaration names one unconfigured customer path and configures a hook to write another; assert only the configured path changes and inspect the CLI for built-in network clients

claim: A receipt covers only its listed versions and supported environments.
where: hero caption, landing limits, demo, README
sandbox: fresh CLI sample demo; inspect JSON and HTML for separate tested-host and declared-support fields plus every explicit limitation

claim: The $79 one-time Team kit adds a CI checklist for supported source and target versions.
sandbox: fresh browser context; recorded valid entitlement; assert exact offer copy and downloaded checklist matrix

claim: The free CLI includes JSON and HTML receipt formats.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory without a license; run sample demo and inspect both receipt files

claim: Dodo Payments is the merchant of record and handles Team kit order questions and returns.
sandbox: fresh clone; recorded product-specific Sociobot checkout redirect and Dodo checkout footer; assert merchant and returns data from the checkout response, then assert matching public copy

claim: Payment opens the product-specific Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the exact checkout URL and absence of a direct provider client

claim: The detected desktop download comes from the matching published GitHub release.
sandbox: fresh browser context; recorded GitHub release response; assert version copy and exact matching asset URL

claim: Install packages are provided for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with no phone or tablet package.
sandbox: recorded published release; assert macOS, Windows, and Linux assets and the absence of Android or iOS assets; assert the mobile explanation

claim: The documented Homebrew tap publishes the current formula.
sandbox: fresh clone; recorded published tap formula; assert documented command, current version, release URLs, and checksums

claim: The documented Scoop bucket publishes a valid selfhost-upgrade-rehearsal manifest.
sandbox: fresh clone; recorded published Scoop manifest; assert current version, Windows asset URL, and SHA256

claim: Release v0.1.5 includes deb, rpm, unsigned pkg, Windows zip, Winget, checksums, and latest manifest assets.
sandbox: fresh clone; recorded v0.1.5 GitHub release response; bind tag to package version and assert every documented asset pattern and digest

claim: Hook arguments expand {source_dir} and {work_dir} to the declaration and temporary workspace directories.
sandbox: fresh temporary declaration; execute a hook with both placeholders and assert its received arguments equal the CLI environment paths

claim: A receipt contains schema changes, declared resource minimums, checks, tested versions, and supported environments.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; run the CLI sample demo and assert every documented receipt field in JSON and customer-facing HTML

claim: A v-prefixed tag runs the cross-platform GitHub release workflow.
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect tag trigger, Linux, macOS, Windows matrix, and GitHub release action

claim: The browser recording and CLI demo use the same bundled Arbor Desk sample demo.
sandbox: fresh browser context and CLI temporary directory; compare product and source-to-target versions

claim: License verification uses the product-specific Sociobot API.
sandbox: fresh browser context; recorded invalid response; assert the exact outbound verification URL

claim: No payment-provider client is embedded in the repository or website.
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect site entry, HTML, and dependency manifest for direct provider clients

claim: The sample demo uses a separate demo session namespace and clears it when the user installs the CLI or closes the tab.
sandbox: fresh browser context with sentinel real storage; enter ?demo=1, inspect namespaces, exit, close the tab, reopen, and assert real data is unchanged

claim: The CLI writes Compose and Kubernetes declaration templates that identify the schemas and hooks to add before checking.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; run init for both adapters; inspect the required schema and hook fields, setup instruction, and missing-schema check failure

claim: The check, run, and demo commands provide machine-readable JSON output.
sandbox: fresh temporary declaration and demo; run all three commands with --json and parse each response

claim: The website reads cached public GitHub release metadata and opens matching GitHub download assets.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record the GitHub API request, assert its matching asset mapping, local cache, and no static-manifest request

claim: License tokens and daily verification verdicts stay in namespaced browser storage.
sandbox: fresh browser context; recorded valid response; assert URL stripping and namespaced token and timestamped verdict

claim: The website does not collect card numbers.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert no card inputs, payment iframe, or third-party runtime script

claim: Sociobot checkout uses Dodo to process payment details.
sandbox: fresh clone; recorded checkout response; assert the Sociobot request and 303 Dodo checkout destination

claim: Development uses stable Rust and Node 22 with npm.
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect the test workflow and package lock for stable Rust, Node 22, and npm

sandbox: fresh clone; inspect the npm test script, Playwright projects, axe test, and claim tags

claim: npm run build:site writes dist/site/index.html.
sandbox: fresh clone after the test prebuild; inspect the build script and built index document

claim: The complete deployable static site is in dist/site.
